t: R.J. Weatherhead, Suspected Agent Of Komintern And Eddie Buchanan

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SECRET
REPORT
S.2, Special Branch D
Date December 11, 1934
Subject (in full) R.J. Weatherhead, suspected agent of Komintern,
and Eddie Buchanan.
Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Ross

According to information received one R.J. Weatherhead,
who is reported to be an official of the Navy Y.M.C.A. at Hankow,
is endeavouring to obtain a large quantity of communist literature
in the English language. In consequence of this report Mr. Ross,
Manager of the local Navy Y.M.C.A., upon being confidentially
approached, stated that the present manager of the Navy "Y" in
Hankow was an American named H.W. Gibson who had taken over the
post during August, 1934 from Dr. J.B. Latimer, who had been
there for the past six years. Mr. Gibson is a graduate of an
American University and prior to coming to China, was in charge
of the Navy Y.M.C.A. in Fort McKinley, P.I.
Continuing, Mr. Ross stated that there was no one answering
to the name of Weatherhead employed in any of the Navy "Y"
institutions in the Far East.
It was then pointed out to Mr. Ross that some person might
possibly be using the Hankow Navy "Y" as an accommodation address
and in this connection he promised to write to Mr. Gibson
confidentially and ascertain whether anyone by the name of
Weatherhead was known to him.
Mr. Ross subsequently communicated with Mr. Gibson who
volunteered the following information:
R.J. Weatherhead, a young weak-looking and unprepossessing
Canadian of about 20 years of age, is employed at the B.C.C.
Hankow. He was formerly residing at the Navy "Y" in Hankow, but
is now living in a Mess. Weatherhead mentioned the name of a
Mrs. C. Solloway, Mission, B.C. Canada, as a person who should
be notified in any emergency in which he, Weatherhead, might be
involved.
He is on friendly terms with a young man named Eddie

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
机密
报告
S.2，特别科 D 组
日期：1934年12月11日
主题（全称）：R.J. Weatherhead，疑似共产国际代理人，以及 Eddie Buchanan。
制作及呈报人：巡官罗斯（D.I. Ross）

根据所获情报，一名名为 R.J. Weatherhead 的男子，据报为汉口海军青年会（Navy Y.M.C.A.）的职员，正试图获取大量英文共产主义文献。鉴于此报告，本地海军青年会经理罗斯先生在被秘密问询时表示，目前汉口海军青年会的经理是一位名叫 H.W. Gibson 的美国人，他于1934年8月从已在此任职六年的 J.B. Latimer 博士手中接任该职。Gibson 先生毕业于美国一所大学，在来华之前，曾负责菲律宾麦克金利堡（Fort McKinley, P.I.）的海军青年会工作。
罗斯先生接着表示，在远东地区的任何海军青年会机构中，均无名为 Weatherhead 的受雇人员。
随后向罗斯先生指出，某人有可能利用汉口海军青年会作为通信转交地址，对此他承诺将秘密致信 Gibson 先生，查明是否有名为 Weatherhead 的人为其所知。
罗斯先生随后与 Gibson 先生取得联系，后者主动提供了以下信息：
R.J. Weatherhead，一名约20岁、外表瘦弱且其貌不扬的加拿大人，受雇于汉口英美烟草公司（B.C.C.）。他此前居住在汉口海军青年会，现居住于一处寄宿舍。Weatherhead 提及了一位名为 C. Solloway 的女士，地址为加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省传教区（Mission, B.C. Canada），称若他本人卷入任何紧急情况，应通知此人。
他与一名名为 Eddie

Buchanan who recently arrived in Hankow from Japan, and on the
latter's own admission, he and Weatherhead whilst on a sight-
seeing tour in Hankow "went too close to the Chinese barracks,
were seized, tied to a pole with their hands behind their backs,
and left to the gaze of coolies, etc. for two hours."

Weatherhead still gets mail addressed to him care of the
Navy "Y".

Buchanan is reported to have left Hankow and is believed
to be at present in Shanghai.

                                    D. I.

Buchanan 的年轻人关系友好，后者最近从日本抵达汉口。据 Buchanan 自述，他和 Weatherhead 在汉口观光游览时，“靠中国兵营太近，被抓获，双手反绑在柱子上，并被留给苦力等人围观了两小时。”

Weatherhead 仍接收寄至海军青年会转交他的邮件。

据报 Buchanan 已离开汉口，目前相信其在上海。
